faq_description: Find answers to all your questions about Work24 here.
faq_q1_question: How can I use it without any device?
faq_q1_answer: You can use it by scanning a QR code or determining your location through the mobile application installed on your smartphone.
faq_q2_question: What is the difference between QR login and location-based login?
faq_q2_answer: With QR login, entry and exit are performed by scanning the QR code. In location-based login, the process is completed by pressing the button on the phone.
faq_q3_question: Can a photo of the QR code be taken and scanned elsewhere?
faq_q3_answer: No. The QR code only works at the coordinates predetermined in the admin panel. It cannot be scanned from a different location, and such attempts can be detected from the admin reports.
faq_q4_question: Can someone log in using another person’s phone?
faq_q4_answer: The system matches MAC addresses. Unless the administrator allows it, entry and exit cannot be made with another device. This can also be detected in the reports.
faq_q5_question: Can Fake GPS applications deceive the system?
faq_q5_answer: No. The Work24 mobile application has an integrated security system that detects fake location (Fake GPS) applications. Manipulation is not possible.
faq_q6_question: Is your system compliant with KVKK?
faq_q6_answer: Yes. Work24 is fully compliant with KVKK. Users cannot log in without downloading the app and accepting the KVKK text. The app only requests camera, location, and notification permissions. When the app is not running, these permissions are not active.
faq_q7_question: How will people without a smartphone use it?
faq_q7_answer: The administrator can manually create entry and exit records.
faq_q8_question: Do I need to install a program on my computer?
faq_q8_answer: No. The system is web-based. You can access it using your username and password without installing any software.
faq_q9_answer: Yes. You can define unlimited administrators for free. You decide the authority levels and accessible sections for each administrator.
faq_q10_answer: You can send notifications to any department or person through the system (e.g., “Don’t forget to clock in”, “Your leave has been approved”).
faq_q11_answer: Yes. With the API offered by Work24, you can integrate with payroll, accounting, ERP, and HR systems.
faq_q12_answer: Yes. You can get detailed reports for any date range based on filters such as department, position, and location.
faq_q13_question: Can it be used in multiple branches?
faq_q13_answer: Yes. Work24 can be used in unlimited branches anywhere in the world.
faq_q14_question: How can I contact for support?
faq_q14_answer: You can reach us between 09:00–17:00 on weekdays at 0216 414 08 90 or info{'@'}work24.io.
faq_q15_question: What if an employee forgets to clock in or out?
faq_q15_answer: The administrator can manually add entry and exit movements.
faq_q16_question: Is it integrated with our current software?
faq_q16_answer: Yes. Thanks to detailed API support, it works in compatibility with many ERP, HR, payroll, and accounting programs.
faq_q17_question: Can the administrator view reports from a mobile device?
faq_q17_answer: Yes. With the administrator mobile app, reports can be viewed without needing a computer.
faq_q18_question: Do you perform installations in different cities?
faq_q19_answer: No. Breaks, annual leave, excuse leave, limited leave, overtime, and all other details can be reported.
faq_q20_answer: Yes. The QR code is fixed and can be printed and placed in a static area. Due to location restrictions, it will not work anywhere else.
faq_q21_answer: With the location-based login feature, employees can clock in and out without QR or a device. Their location does not matter.
faq_q22_answer: Yes. Employees’ break durations and details can be reported.
faq_q23_answer: Yes. You can export all reports in XLS, CSV, or PDF formats.
faq_q24_question: What is the difference between monthly and annual purchase?
faq_q24_answer: Annual purchase is more advantageous, but monthly purchase is also available. There is no difference in usage.
faq_q25_question: Can I switch between Basic, ProTeam, and Enterprise Packages?
faq_q25_answer: Yes. You can switch by paying the price difference for the months you will use.
faq_q26_question: Can I upgrade my package later?
faq_q26_answer: Yes. You can upgrade to a higher package. You only need to pay the difference for the months of use.
faq_q27_answer: Yes. Refund is calculated as (Remaining months × monthly service fee) – installation cost.
faq_q28_question: Do you have a demo period? Is it paid?
faq_q28_answer: Our demo period is completely free.
faq_q29_question: Is there WhatsApp or live support?
faq_q29_answer: For now, only call center and email support are available.
faq_q30_question: Can I request leave through the mobile app?
faq_q30_answer: Yes. You can request all types of leaves, report overtime, and access your personal reports.
faq_q31_question: How does the cloud system work?
faq_q31_answer: The software is hosted in secure data centers owned by Work24. No server setup is required. The cloud system provides cost advantages, flexibility, and easy management.
faq_q32_answer: No. Work24 works only with the cloud system.
faq_q33_question: How can I upload employees to the system?
faq_q33_answer: You can upload employees individually or in bulk via an Excel file.
faq_q34_answer: Yes. Work24 is compatible with global time zones. It automatically calculates time differences and can be used in any country.
faq_q35_answer: PDKS stands for Personnel Attendance Control System and refers to solutions that enable electronic tracking of employee entry–exit, overtime, leave, and absenteeism information.
faq_q36_question: What are the advantages of using PDKS?
faq_q36_answer: It automates attendance and overtime tracking, speeds up payroll processes, ensures transparency in overtime calculations, and significantly reduces HR reporting workload.
faq_q37_question: Is the PDKS system suitable for small businesses?
faq_q37_answer: Yes. Even small businesses benefit from automated entry–exit and overtime tracking for transparent and fair personnel management.
faq_q38_answer: Cloud-based PDKS stores attendance data in a secure cloud infrastructure, enabling multi-location management and automatic updates.
faq_q39_question: How do you ensure the accuracy of entry–exit operations?
faq_q39_answer: We compare the locations of entry–exit points with your personnel’s location, preventing employees from clocking in outside the defined location.
faq_q40_answer: Yes. The system includes a uniquely designed shift tracking module that provides accurate results without manual intervention.
